queries.To address the core research question, t: end-to-end trainable multivariate time series forecasting model integrating temporal dependencies and causal relationships using transfer entropy, causal graph neural network, patchified temporal embedding, and attention sequence enhancement
queries.To estimate causal dependencies in multi: Pseudo transfer entropy with Gaussian normal distribution assumptions for computing causal weights and causal dependencies in multivariate time series forecasting, including fast pseudo transfer entropy complexity reduction for patchified temporal series and causal graph neural network forecasting
queries.To make causal weighting computationally: fast pseudo transfer entropy algorithm for causal weighting in multivariate time series forecasting that flattens patchified series in the last two dimensions to reduce complexity from quadratic to linear in sequence length
queries.To combine the estimated causal structur: Causal graph neural network that uses transfer entropy causality matrix as adjacency to aggregate multivariate time series patches with a 2D mixer for within and across patch information in forecasting
queries.To represent each time series as patch-b: cross-temporal patch embedding for multivariate time series forecasting that converts individual time series into two-dimensional patch tensors and projects them into a latent space instead of treating simultaneous data points as column vectors
queries.To enhance sequences before causal proce: multi-head attention sequence enhancer for patchified multivariate time series forecasting that shares cross-patch patterns using auto-regressive dependencies before causal transfer entropy processing
queries.To enable practical adoption in existing: conventional attention framework drop-in replacement for attention modules in multivariate time series forecasting with causal transfer entropy and temporal dependencies
queries.To validate the approach across real-wor: Multivariate time series forecasting experiments on ETT, Weather, Exchange-rate, and financial index datasets evaluating a causal transfer entropy model with attention, patch embedding, and graph neural network against DLinear, TiDE, iTransformer, PatchTST, Crossformer, Stationary, and TimesNet using MSE and MAE.
queries.To benchmark against current practice, t: benchmarking multivariate time series forecasting against state-of-the-art models DLinear TiDE RLinear iTransformer PatchTST Crossformer Stationary TimesNet
queries.To standardize forecasting evaluation, t: multivariate time series forecasting benchmark setup with fixed lookback length 96 and forecast horizons 96 192 336 720 for ETT weather exchange rate datasets and 48 96 192 336 for financial indices evaluated by MSE and MAE
queries.To measure forecasting accuracy, the pla: Evaluating multivariate time series forecasting models with mean squared error and mean absolute error across short and long prediction horizons using causal transfer entropy and attention-based baselines
queries.To standardize implementation, the plan: PyTorch implementation of multivariate time series forecasting on NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU using causal transfer entropy and attention-based models
queries.To isolate the contribution of causal we: Ablation study replacing pseudo transfer entropy causal weighting with conventional attention in a multivariate time series forecasting model, measuring effects on forecasting accuracy and learned causal relationships.
queries.To test the role of sequence enhancement: Ablation study effect of removing the Sequence Enhancer module in multivariate time series forecasting with patchified temporal embeddings, multi-head attention, transfer entropy, causal graph neural network
queries.To assess the contribution of the encode: Ablation study measuring the contribution of the entire encoder structure in SPACE, a multivariate time series forecasting model combining temporal patch embedding, sequence enhancement, transfer entropy causal weights, and a causal graph neural network.
